A limit that far below the market is not a live idea, it is a trap: the only path back to 54.00 is a 16% energy drawdown, and if that happens the reason will be a demand shock that invalidates the thesis rather than a discount that honours it. recommendations.counter_argument: The strongest case against cancelling is to convert instead: the thesis was right about direction and only wrong about price, so the disciplined response might be to re-pitch at a reachable level rather than abandon it. I considered a re-entry in the 59-60 zone near the 59.99 twenty-day and 59.82 fifty-day averages, and rejected it, because I could not establish any dated cause for Friday's 4.32% move in oil. Re-pitching into an unexplained gap is how a stale idea becomes a worse one, and with XOM and CVX both reporting Friday the honest position in energy this week is smaller, not relocated.

An order that fills when the thesis is intact is worth keeping; one that fills only when it is broken is not.

recommendations.thesis: This is a trigger, not a position: short December micro bitcoin only on a daily close below 79,263. Bitcoin has spent thirty days in an 79,263-87,086 range and sits 1.3% off the floor of it at 80,255, inside a longer pattern of lower highs — 114,419 a year ago, 87,086 this month. The macro case for the break is that a Fed still raising rates into 3.72% inflation is the exact regime in which a non-yielding asset de-rates, and gold has already fallen 18% on that mechanism while bitcoin has only gone sideways. The reason this is conditional rather than live is that the thesis and the level disagree right now: selling at the bottom of a range that has held repeatedly is a bad entry even when the direction is right.
recommendations.key_risk: Two risks, and the second is the one to watch. First, the range holds: 79,263 has been defended all month, bitcoin bounced off roughly this zone in April as well, and a short triggered on a marginal break gets squeezed back into the range for a full 5,130-point stop. Second and more important, this is the third idea in today's book whose outcome depends on the Fed path, alongside the TLT short and the ITB short — that is at the correlation cap of three, and a dovish surprise on Wednesday hurts all three at once. Size accordingly: 1.5% here, not more, and if TLT and ITB are both still open when the trigger fires, take this at 1% instead. RED TEAM: third, and this is a defect in the order rather than in the thesis — the 2.0:1 is computed off a 79,000 trigger the entry mechanism may never deliver. A 30-day low breaking on a 2.55% ATR routinely closes thousands of points through it, and filled at 77,000 with the stop unchanged the ratio is 8,260/7,130 = 1.16:1, under the floor. The stand-down rule added to the action above is therefore load-bearing, not advisory: no fill below 78,200, ever, on this ticket.
recommendations.counter_argument: The strongest case against is that bitcoin has already done its de-rating and is basing, not topping: it is 30% below last October's 114,419 and has spent six months between roughly 62,800 and 87,100 without making a new low since June, which is accumulation behaviour rather than distribution. If that is right, a hawkish Fed is already in the price and the break below 79,263 is a stop-run that reverses. I accept that reading is live, and it is precisely why there is no position until the level actually closes below — the trigger exists to make the market settle this argument rather than me.
